fit_reason: This is a 1949 Ford panel project vehicle with no engine installed, bare surface-rust paint, exposed wiring and missing door glass. It is a restoration or rat rod project, not something a detail would prepare for sale. The worn patina and bodywork needs are outside what detailing addresses.
findings: Faded, worn-through original paint with surface rust patina across the hood, fenders and door; this is beyond buffing and is part of the rat rod look
Interior dash and steering column are dusty, but the cab is mid-project with loose hanging wiring under the dash
Engine bay is empty, and the seller describes the vehicle as a project
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 1949 Ford panel. It looks like a great project with that original patina on the hood and fenders. That finish is part of its character, so we wouldn't try to polish it. If you ever want the cab or dash cleaned up before showing it, we're local and come to you, so feel free to reach out for a quote.
